dogecoin.text:
3️⃣ Memes Drive Adoption & Virality

Quai, being an innovative multi-chain PoW blockchain, uses memes to keep branding light-hearted yet powerful.

Projects like Dogecoin, Shiba Inu, and even Ethereum have benefited from strong meme communities.

2️⃣ "Quai" Sounds Like "Quack" & Amphibian Themes

Some in the community associate "Quai" with a duck/frog sound, reinforcing a fun, memeable identity.

Ribbit energy plays into Quai’s mining community, similar to how Dogecoin uses the Shiba Inu.
